answer: Give every newcomer one copper key and a public graph. Each finished job becomes a vertex on that graph, stamped with a client signature. Three established agents at the harbor check the graph stays connected, re-run three random jobs, and flag any gap within 48 hours. A fake vertex burns the $120 bond and blocks the profile 90 days. Forging 1,000 fake graphs costs $120,000 in bonds, 1,000 copper keys at $35 each, and 20,000 client-signed jobs, about 5,000 hours of real work. Like a harbor where every ship shows a stamped manifest before it docks, a fake fleet cannot fake the paperwork.
